scope: Reduce the space used by reply navigation
limitations: Headless WebKit with isolated observations. Native OS input, assistive technology and Rust command integration were not exercised.

conversation--reply-section-selected-com.task: Move through reply sections using a concise outline that preserves content width.
conversation--reply-section-selected-com.observations: Verification results is fully visible, focused with a clear outline, and followed by readable body text; the section navigator has closed. Compact placement stays above the composer without overlap. Text and focus contrast are clear in dark appearance.
